title: Big Brain Chug
subtitle: The history, science and maths hiding in Fortnite
version_note: Game details from Chapter 7 Season 4 (Override), Fortnitemares update v42.30, as of 12 October 2026. History, science and maths facts checked October 2026.
description: An unofficial Fortnite fan book that follows the Battle Bus, the storm, shields, building, Sprites and the Item Shop into real history, science and maths, with puzzles in every chapter and the answers explained at the back.
glossary_blurb: Every Word Watch word in this book, from A to Z. Pick three you didn't know before, and try to use each one this week. Bonus points for explaining one to a grown-up.

chapters.title: Before You Drop
chapters.toc: How to use this book (and a perfect warm-up)
chapters.label: Start here
chapters.dek: Fortnite is secretly stuffed with history, science and maths. Here's how to find it, plus a warm-up that proves Geno isn't perfect.

chapters.title: Bus Stop Science
chapters.toc: Falling, floating and the first parachutes
chapters.dek: You jump out of the Battle Bus every single match. So why do things fall, and who was brave enough to jump first?

chapters.title: Storm Maths
chapters.toc: Why the storm circle shrinks faster than you think
chapters.dek: The storm circle gets half as wide, but you lose three-quarters of your space. Meet the circle, the number pi, and the ancient genius who trapped it.

chapters.title: Shield Sums
chapters.toc: Health bars, shield bars and the Romans
chapters.dek: Health goes up to 100. Shield goes up to 100. That makes your health bar the best fractions teacher in the world.

chapters.title: Block Party
chapters.toc: Tetris, tetrominoes and shapes that tile
chapters.dek: Giant falling blocks squashed a whole town on the Island. Here's the true story of the game they came from, and the maths of fitting shapes together.

chapters.title: Gotta Go Fast
chapters.toc: Speed, sound and the sound barrier
chapters.dek: Green Hill Zone is all about speed. So how fast is fast? From Usain Bolt to Concorde, and the pilot who flew faster than sound with two broken ribs.

chapters.title: Chomp Logic
chapters.toc: Ghost rules, algorithms and the first programmers
chapters.dek: The four ghosts that haunt the Island's arcade islands each follow a simple set of rules. That makes them algorithms, and algorithms run the world.

chapters.title: Builder's Brain
chapters.toc: Triangles, arches, pyramids and the Coathanger
chapters.dek: Why does a triangle stay strong when a square wobbles? From the pyramids to the Sydney Harbour Bridge, the secrets of building things that stand up.

chapters.title: Map Masters
chapters.toc: Grid references, compasses and stretchy maps
chapters.dek: "Enemy at D5!" Every squad callout is a coordinate. Learn to read a grid, use a compass, and spot a map that's telling fibs.

chapters.title: Vault Codes
chapters.toc: Caesar, Morse, Enigma and the vault
chapters.dek: The Temple Vault needs two keys. Real secrets need something cleverer: codes. Crack messages from Julius Caesar, the telegraph and the greatest code-breakers in history.

chapters.title: Sprite Science
chapters.toc: Bees, hexagons, dancing directions and helpful bats
chapters.dek: Sprites have superpowers. So do real animals. Meet the bees that build in perfect hexagons and dance directions, and the vampire bats who share their dinner.

chapters.title: Shop Smarts
chapters.toc: Best value, sneaky adverts and tulip mania
chapters.dek: The Item Shop is designed to make you want things. Learn the maths of good value, the tricks adverts use, and the strange story of the most expensive flowers in history.

chapters.title: Mythbusters Medkit
chapters.toc: Lucky skins, cartridge myths and how to test anything
chapters.dek: Does blowing into a game cartridge fix it? Does a lucky outfit help you win? Here's how scientists find out what's really true.

chapters.title: Numbers Don't Lie
chapters.toc: Averages, charts and two data heroes
chapters.dek: The world championship was decided by two points. Learn to read the table, find the average, spot a sneaky chart, and meet the nurse who saved lives with a diagram.

chapters.title: The Final Circle
chapters.toc: Ten challenges using every skill in the book
chapters.dek: The storm is closing. Ten challenges stand between you and a Victory Royale, and each one uses something from earlier in the book.

chapters.title: How to Think It Through
chapters.toc: Every answer, and how to get there
chapters.label: Back of the book
chapters.dek: Every answer in the book, with the thinking that gets you there. Got one wrong? Brilliant. That's where the learning is.

chapters.title: The Brain Bank
chapters.toc: Every Word Watch word, A to Z
chapters.label: Back of the book
